description: Structured metadata query — filter notes by frontmatter key/value predicates, tag, folder, modified time, and size. Returns compact rows (path + title by default; opt into more via select), not note content. Use this instead of search when filtering by properties rather than text.

folder.description: Restrict to a vault-relative folder prefix.

maxSizeBytes.description: Only notes at most this many bytes.

minSizeBytes.description: Only notes at least this many bytes.

modifiedAfter.description: Only notes modified at or after this ISO 8601 date/time.

modifiedBefore.description: Only notes modified before this ISO 8601 date/time.

select.description: Extra fields per hit: frontmatter keys, or "mtime", "size", "tags". Default returns only path + title.

tag.description: Restrict to notes with this tag. # optional, case-insensitive; nested child tags match ("project" matches project/alpha).

op.description: eq/ne compare scalars; contains matches array membership or substring; exists/missing test key presence; gt/gte/lt/lte compare numbers or strings (ISO dates sort correctly).

value.description: Comparison value. Required for every op except exists/missing.

name: query_notes
